fields.desc: Optional clarification of what your proxies represent or how they move, for example: 'The moving block represents a running person.' Camera, trajectories, timing and object count remain defined by the video.

fields.name: video_url
fields.desc: Blender video, up to 15 seconds and 32 shots, at a public HTTPS URL.

fields.name: max_generated_reference_images
fields.desc: Maximum NEW images to generate when no reference images are supplied. Ignored when reference images are supplied. Uses fewer when enough views are covered. Uncovered shots stay in the video.

fields.name: resolution
fields.desc: Output quality. Duration is taken automatically from the video.

fields.name: reference_image_urls
fields.desc: Optional environment, subject, interior or detail references. When supplied, uses these images directly without visual planning or generating new images; Scene Intent is optional. Without references, automatically creates appearance references within your new-image limit. Camera and movement always come from the video.

fields.name: enable_safety_checker
fields.desc: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

fields.name: prompt
fields.desc: Text prompt for video generation. Camera movement instructions can be added using square brackets (e.g. [Pan left] or [Zoom in]). You can use up to 3 combined movements per prompt. Supported movements: Truck left/right, Pan left/right, Push in/Pull out, Pedestal up/down, Tilt up/down, Zoom in/out, Shake, Tracking shot, Static shot. For example: [Truck left, Pan right, Zoom in]. For a more detailed guide, refer https://sixth-switch-2ac.notion.site/T2V-01-Director-Model-Tutorial-with-camera-movement-1886c20a98eb80f395b8e05291ad8645

fields.name: prompt_optimizer
fields.desc: Whether to use the model's prompt optimizer

fields.name: image_url
fields.desc: URL of the image to use as the first frame
